summary.text: Apply online, or get a form, complete it, and send it with any required documents.

steps.name: Choose an application method
steps.text: Apply online using the link. Alternatively, pick up a CHAS form at any Community Centre or Club, Community Development Council, public hospital or polyclinic, or download the form.

steps.name: Complete the form
steps.text: Complete and sign the CHAS application form.

steps.name: Add documents if needed
steps.text: If anyone in your household is not a Singapore Citizen, include copies of their foreign identification documents.

steps.name: Send the form
steps.text: Send the completed and signed application form to Privy Box No. 920231, Singapore 929292.

example_phrasings: How do I apply for CHAS?
Where can I get a CHAS application form?

quotes.text: You can apply for CHAS via the online application by using this link.

Alternatively, you can also pick up a CHAS application form at any Community Centre or Club (CC), Community Development Council (CDC), Public Hospital or Polyclinic or download the application form by using this link .
Please send the completed and signed application form to Privy Box No. 920231, Singapore 929292.
If anyone in your household is not a Singapore Citizen, please also include copies of their foreign identification documents (e.g. work permit/long term visit pass).
